title: Sonchiriya
desc: After their leader's death, a notorious dacoit gang splits into factions. In their journey forward, they cross paths with Indumati and Khushi, sparking unexpected turns and emotional revelations.

title: Phobia
desc: Mehak becomes a victim of agoraphobia. Later, she comes across something that makes her believe that she is being haunted by a spirit.

title: Bob Biswas
desc: Following The Violent 2002 Riots In Gujarat, People Who Were Victims, Perpetrators And Silent Observers During The Chaos, Find Themselves Deeply Affected In A Way That Changes Their Lives Forever.

title: Raanjhanaa
desc: A boy from a small town falls in love across class lines and must fight against social prejudice and expectations to prove that love matters more than status.

title: Gully Boy
desc: A street rapper from Mumbai's slums rises against odds to voice truth through music, blending dreams, rebellion, and rhythm in a story of resilience.

title: Omerta
desc: Ahmed Omar Sheikh, driven by deep hatred, abducts and kills journalist Daniel Pearl, shaking the world with one of the most chilling acts of terrorism and revenge.

title: Crew
desc: Three dedicated women find themselves tangled in unexpected situations, navigating a tricky web of lies that challenges their friendships and tests their resilience.

title: Beyond The Clouds
desc: The emotional story of siblings reunited by a drug bust, navigating hardship and hope in the slums of Mumbai as they struggle for survival, forgiveness, and dignity.

title: The Last Color
desc: 9-year-old Choti wishes to attend school but she faces struggle for daily survival. She befriends a widow who lives a life of abstinence. She later becomes an advocate and fights for societal reforms.

title: Chakravyuh
desc: Adil recruits Kabir to spy on Naxals. The mission succeeds, but Kabir grows sympathetic to their cause, causing conflict with Adil and challenging their friendship.

title: Mere Pyare Prime Minister
desc: A traumatised young boy, seeking justice for personal tragedy, writes to the Prime Minister and embarks on a brave journey across the country in search of truth and closure.
